objectives.title: Given business requirements, identify when it's appropriate to use Prompt Builder.
Identify access controls governing prompt templates.
Identify the considerations for using a prompt template type such as field generation and flex types.
Given a scenario, identify the appropriate grounding technique.
Explain the process for creating, activating, and executing prompt templates.
Explain how to implement best practices for writing effective prompts.
Identify the security and privacy features of the Trust Layer.
Explain how to manage and prevent specific models from being accessed.
Explain the considerations of Agentforce Data Library and its concepts.
Explain foundational concepts of Data 360 such as chunking, indexing, and retrievers.
Explain how an agent works and its basic building blocks of agent script.
Explain the components and benefits of hybrid reasoning, including how Agent Script functions in Canvas and Script View.
Given a use case, manage deterministic behavior for the agent using mechanisms like filters, variables, and template expressions.
Given a scenario, select and configure standard topics, custom topics, standard Agent actions, and custom Agent actions.
Explain the process for connecting agents to various channels such as digital experience, email, voice, and Slack.
Explain the security context in which the agent is actually running, and how it impacts agent action execution.
Given a scenario, identify when to use an Employee or Service agent.
Given a scenario, identify when it's appropriate to use Agent API.
Given a scenario, test an agent using Testing Center.
Explain how Testing Center evaluations work.
Identify the considerations for deploying an agent from sandbox to production.
Identify the considerations for deploying a template from sandbox to production.
Explain the process for managing and monitoring agents.
Explain agent analytics and agent optimization
Given a scenario, determine whether a Single-Agent (SOMA) architecture is appropriate for scalability and control.
Explain the purpose of existing open standard multi-agent protocols such as MCP and A2A.

exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or reference materials. No access to Salesforce org. Proctor monitors via webcam.
id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID. Name must match Webassessor registration exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Salesforce still sells this exam, under the name it now uses for it: the credential URL trailhead.salesforce.com/en/credentials/aispecialist redirects to /en/credentials/agentforcespecialist, headed 'Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist' - 'Certified Agentforce Specialists are responsible for managing and optimizing Agentforce and have deep understanding of both Salesforce platform configuration and Agentforce capabilities.' The exam guide is live: 'Content: 60 multiple-choice questions and up to five unscored questions Time allotted to complete the exam: 105 minutes Passing score: 72% Version: Exam questions align to the Spring '26 release. Registration fee: USD 200'.

official_study_resources.notes: Free official learning platform with trails aligned to each certification
official_study_resources.title: Salesforce Trailhead

official_study_resources.notes: Free exam guides with sample questions on each credential page
official_study_resources.title: Salesforce Exam Guide & Sample Questions

recommended_experience: 1 year of experience with Salesforce platform configuration and standard objects, including Data 360. Hands-on experience building agents in Agentforce Agent Builder and creating prompt templates in Prompt Builder.
renewal_options: Salesforce releases three major updates per year. For each release, certified professionals must complete a free maintenance module on Trailhead to retain their certification. No cost for maintenance.

retake_policy.notes: Retake available after scheduling (no mandatory waiting period for first retake). Retake fee ~$100 for most exams.

target_audience: Administrators, Developers, and Architects who configure Prompt Builder for grounding, leverage Data 360 for retrieval, and manage the Development Lifecycle of agents from testing to production.

testing_centers.notes: In-person and online proctored via Kryterion Webassessor
